name: Fighter
description: A trained fighter who stands in front and wins by steel and endurance.

name: Mage
description: A scholar of the arcane who bends raw magic into fire, frost and storm.

name: Cleric
description: A servant of the gods who heals allies and smites the unholy.

name: Rogue
description: A quick and cunning blade who strikes where the enemy is weakest.

name: Barbarian
description: A fierce brawler who turns rage into raw, unstoppable strength.

name: Paladin
description: A holy knight bound by an oath, shield of the weak and bane of evil.

name: Monk
description: A disciplined fighter whose body and spirit are the only weapons needed.

name: Warlock
description: A seeker who made a pact with a dark patron in exchange for power.

name: Druid
description: A keeper of the wild who calls on nature and takes the shapes of beasts.
